source_name: EFFIS / Copernicus Fire Weather Index forecast
text: EFFIS Fire Weather Index peaks at 47.9 — 'very high' on the EFFIS scale — at Alagón (stage 14) on 2026-10-18, across a 3-day forecast from 2026-10-16. 10 stage endpoint(s) reach 'high' (>= 21.3) or worse: Alagón (stage 14) 48, Gallur (stage 13) 45, Alagón (stage 14) 42, Gallur (stage 13) 40, Alfaro (stage 11) 39, Zaragoza (stage 15) 36. At 'very high' or above: stages [11, 13, 14]. FWI anomaly at Alagón is +4.8 versus the seasonal norm. Reported because: changed. Classes: low <11.2, moderate 11.2-21.3, high 21.3-38, very high 38-50, extreme 50-70, very extreme >70.
